title: DGTF-Net: code and results for 'Gated Fusion of Adaptive Graph Attention and Temporal Transformers for Accurate Urban Traffic Congestion Prediction'
description: Implementation of DGTF-Net, the experiment code and notebook, wrappers that run STGCN, DCRNN, Graph WaveNet (BasicTS), STAEformer, STID, AGCRN, D2STGNN and MegaCRN at pinned commits in one shared training loop, and the per-run results (122 runs on PEMS08 and PEMS04) behind every table and figure of the revised manuscript submitted to Discover Computing.
